entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse cast in response to the New Phyrexian Invasion by Talion and the witch sisters, leaving victims asleep in violet mist.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion that devastated Eldraine.

entities.name: Talion
entities.description: The fae Lord of the Wilds who helped cast the Wicked Slumber; father of Obyra.

entities.name: Agatha
entities.description: One of the three witch sisters, owner of the Soul Cauldron.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: Witch sister who extended the curse to the living inhabitants and taught Rowan to control sleepers.

entities.name: Hylda
entities.description: One of the three witch sisters, owner of the Crown of Winter.

entities.name: Soul Cauldron
entities.description: Magical artifact given to Agatha by Talion.

entities.name: Tempting Apple
entities.description: Magical artifact given to Eriette by Talion.

entities.name: Crown of Winter
entities.description: Magical artifact given to Hylda by Talion.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: Planeswalker able to control those in the Slumber and who used inhabitants' nightmares against the awake.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Kenrith twin taught by Eriette to control the Slumber; one of the Kenrith twins.

entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: Kenrith twin acting as king who ordered victims placed in glass caskets.

entities.name: Algenus
entities.description: High King of Eldraine, killed in the Invasion.

entities.name: Linden Kenrith
entities.description: Queen of Eldraine, killed in the Invasion.

entities.name: Ayara
entities.description: Compleated during the Invasion along with her guards.

entities.name: Castle Locthwain
entities.description: Castle whose inhabitants were compleated.

entities.name: Obyra
entities.description: Talion's child, afflicted by the curse.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: Knight tasked by Talion to kill the three witches, caught by Agatha.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: Half-fae who succeeded in killing the witches and breaking the curse.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: Plane afflicted by the Invasion and the Slumber.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Artifact whose appearance preceded the fall of the courts.

events.summary: Eldraine's courts fall within days of Realmbreaker's appearance; the High King and Queen are killed and Ayara is compleated.
events.quote: High King Algenus and Queen Linden Kenrith were killed

events.summary: Talion joins the witch sisters to cast the Wicked Slumber to halt the Invasion, giving each a magical artifact.
events.quote: Talion provided each of the witches with a magical artifact that enhanced their powers

events.summary: Eriette extends the curse to the living inhabitants, including Talion's child Obyra.
events.quote: Eriette extended the curse to the plane's living inhabitants

events.summary: Ashiok uses inhabitants' nightmares against those still awake.
events.quote: Ashiok took advantage of this slumber to use the inhabitants' nightmares against those still awake

events.summary: Will orders victims of the curse placed in glass caskets.
events.quote: As acting king, Will ordered that victims of the curse be placed in glass caskets to protect them.

events.summary: Talion tasks Imodane to kill the witches; she is caught by Agatha.
events.quote: Talion tasked the knight Imodane to kill the three witches.

events.summary: Talion hands the task to Kellan, who succeeds and breaks the curse but declines his reward.
events.quote: Kellan eventually succeeded in the quest, breaking the curse, though he declined his reward.

relations.quote: was forced to join with the three witch sisters Agatha , Eriette , and Hylda to cast the Wicked Slumber

relations.note: Taught him to control those in the Slumber.
relations.quote: Eriette in turn began teaching the ability to Rowan

relations.note: Tasked to kill the three witches.
relations.quote: Talion handed the task to the half-fae Kellan
